gaps.sentence: A car remained ___ at the traffic lights for ages.
gaps.explanation: 'Stationary' means not moving; 'stationery' means pens, paper and other writing materials.

gaps.sentence: I couldn't ___ what he was saying because of the noise.
gaps.explanation: 'Hear' means to receive sound; 'listen' means to pay attention deliberately and needs 'to'.

gaps.sentence: She studied ___ for her final exams.
gaps.hint: adverb meaning with a lot of effort
gaps.explanation: 'Hard' is an adverb meaning with great effort ('work hard'); 'hardly' means almost not at all.

gaps.sentence: You ___ a lot of water by having such long showers.
gaps.hint: to use something valuable without needing to
gaps.explanation: 'Waste' means to use more than necessary; 'save' means the opposite — to avoid using.

gaps.sentence: I can still ___ the day we first met.
gaps.hint: to keep in your memory yourself
gaps.explanation: 'Remember' means to keep something in your memory; 'remind' means to make someone else remember.

gaps.sentence: This smell ___ me of my childhood.
gaps.explanation: 'Remind somebody of something' means to make someone think of something; 'remember' is not followed by an object + of.

gaps.sentence: He ___ that he would be late.
gaps.hint: '___ that ...' without a listener as object
gaps.explanation: 'Say' is used with reported content ('say that ...') without a person object; 'tell' needs one (tell me that ...).

gaps.sentence: Teenagers ___ hours every day on social media.
gaps.hint: to use time or money on something (neutral)
gaps.explanation: 'Spend time/money on something' is the neutral verb for using time or money; 'waste' implies useless use.
